description:
FilMode is a free video editor and video maker for Android, built around a real multi-track timeline instead of a wizard. Drop in your clips, cut to the frame, stack text, music and voice on their own tracks, then export a clean MP4 up to 4K. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is watermarked, and you never create an account.

NO WATERMARK. NO SIGN-UP.

Every export leaves FilMode clean — no logo in the corner, no end card. No login screen, no banner, no interrupting ad. The one ad is a reward video you tap on the pricing screen to unlock Pro free for 24 hours.

EDITS OFFLINE

The editor runs entirely on your phone: it works in airplane mode, and your footage never leaves the device.

A TIMELINE THAT BEHAVES LIKE ONE

• Video, audio, text and overlay each on their own track

• Pinch to zoom; magnetic snapping with haptic feedback

• Thumbnail strips and live audio waveforms

• Split, trim, ripple delete, duplicate, reorder

• Merge and join several clips into one movie

• Unlimited undo and redo

SLOW MOTION AND SPEED RAMPS

Hold a constant 0.25x to 4x, or draw a Bezier speed curve that eases in and back out. Freeze a frame and hold it. Pitch lock is on by default, so a slowed voice stays a voice.

TRANSITIONS THAT REALLY OVERLAP

Dissolve, fade to black or white, slide, zoom, wipe and blur swap — rendered on the GPU with the two clips genuinely overlapping and the audio cross-fading too, not an opacity dip pretending to be a transition.

KEYFRAME ANIMATION

Animate position, scale, rotation, opacity and volume, with easing. Split an animated clip and the animation survives the cut instead of resetting.

TEXT, TITLES AND CAPTIONS

Type size is measured against the project frame, so a caption looks identical in a 720p draft, in the 4K export, and on a friend's phone.

NARRATION FROM YOUR SCRIPT

Paste a script, pick a voice and set its pitch and speed — text to speech lays the narration onto the timeline as an ordinary audio clip you can move, trim and fade. No microphone involved: FilMode does not record audio.

FILTERS, LUTS AND COLOUR

Filters, LUTs, brightness, contrast, saturation and warmth — every slider previews live while you drag it.

MUSIC AND AUDIO

Background music, per-clip volume, fade in and fade out, and automatic cross-fades that ride along with every visual transition.

STICKERS, PICTURE IN PICTURE, PHOTO MOTION

Layer stickers and picture-in-picture video with blend modes and opacity. Still photos get a Ken Burns move so a slideshow never sits flat.

SIX TEMPLATES INCLUDED

Pick a template, drop your clips into the slots, and the cuts, captions and music are already timed. A finished short in about a minute — then change anything you like.

QUICK ON ORDINARY PHONES

Importing builds a 960p proxy so scrubbing stays smooth, while every export goes back to your original footage and runs through the phone's own hardware encoder.

FREE CORE — AND WHAT PRO ADDS

Trimming, splitting, speed, transitions, keyframes, text, filters, audio and export up to 4K are free, with no watermark. FilMode Pro adds the premium colour filters and turns the reward video off. That is the whole difference — nothing else in the editor is behind the paywall.

Prefer not to pay? Watch one rewarded video and every Pro filter unlocks for 24 hours. No purchase, no account.

PERMISSIONS: ONE, ON OLD ANDROID ONLY

FilMode asks for one permission, on Android 7–9 only: storage, when you save a finished video to your Gallery. Say no and the export still succeeds. Android 10 and later ask nothing. Clips arrive through the system photo picker, so the app never reads your whole gallery. Editing uses the network only for anonymous usage and crash diagnostics — turn that off in the Me tab and it stops. The one exception is the reward video: a non-personalised Unity ad, using the advertising ID only to cap repeats. No location, no contacts, no microphone.

Requires Android 7.0 or newer.

Support: fighttech.vn@gmail.com

Privacy: https://videomaker.filmode.app/privacy.html

Fix subtitle text and timing on your Android phone. Open an SRT or WebVTT file, correct a line, check the timing and export a new copy.

Editing, checks and every export are free. Search and replace repeated text, shift timing earlier or later, and undo the last change. Timing starts with the selected cue only; choose ripple mode explicitly to shift later cues. Previews show how many cues will change.

Check overlapping cues, short gaps, reading speed, crowded lines, empty cues and invalid times. Findings identify the affected cue without silently changing your file. You can select a local video to compare the subtitles with playback, but editing and export also work without one.

Private drafts retain saved edits and unfinished cue text for recovery. Undo history restarts after recovery. Exports create a new file rather than overwriting the original. The app reads the exported copy back before confirming it.

A one-time Pro purchase adds cue split and join, range stretch and batch conversion of up to 50 SRT or WebVTT files. Restore purchases is included. Google Play shows the local price before purchase; there is no subscription.

Subtitle processing stays on your device. There are no ads or mandatory accounts. Sharing sends the exported file only to the app you choose; purchases use Google Play.

Supports SubRip and WebVTT, not ASS or SSA. This is an editor for existing subtitle files, not an automatic caption generator. It does not transcribe audio or display a waveform. Malformed or unsupported input may be refused rather than exported with damaged text.

Main VicoHome Features

Live camera viewing

Because the app focuses on timely updates, it can be helpful for watching deliveries, noticing visitors, or checking unexpected activity near a monitored space.

If your camera is supported, the app can bring live viewing, alerts, playback, and camera settings into one place.

Since camera features can depend on the model, storage method, and account settings, users should check their own camera options inside the app after installation. Everyday Uses For VicoHome

VicoHome fits common monitoring needs where quick checking is more important than complex control. You can use it to see whether a delivery arrived, confirm that a family member got home, look at a pet during the day, or check an office entrance after hours. In these situations, the app helps you move from a notification to a camera view or recording without searching through separate tools.

For users comparing whether a VicoHome APK is worth installing, the main decision depends on camera ownership and monitoring needs. How To Use VicoHome On Android

**Ray Player – IPTV, M3U & Xtream Player**

Ray Player is a modern IPTV player designed to play your M3U, M3U8 and Xtream sources on Android TV, Google TV, TV Box, phones and tablets.

Ray Player does not provide TV channels, movies, series, sports content or IPTV subscriptions. Add your own legal playlists and media sources and enjoy them in one modern player.

**Key Features**

• M3U and M3U8 playlist support

• Xtream Codes support

• Live TV and IPTV playback

• EPG and XMLTV support

• Catch-up support

• VOD support for movies and series

• Multiple audio tracks and subtitles

• 4K and HDR playback support

• Picture-in-Picture (PiP)

• Background audio playback

• Playback speed, aspect ratio, zoom and display controls

• Sleep timer

**Designed for Android TV and TV Box**

Ray Player is optimized for the big-screen experience. Easy remote navigation, D-pad focus management and a TV-friendly interface make it comfortable to use on Android TV and TV Box devices.

Performance-focused options are also available for lower-powered devices, helping reduce resource usage and provide a smoother experience.

**Advanced Playback**

Ray Player can use different playback engines depending on device and content compatibility. Media3/ExoPlayer and MediaKit/libmpv based playback options provide compatibility with a wide range of streaming and media formats.

Depending on the device and source, supported audio and subtitle formats may include AC3, E-AC3, DTS, SRT and VTT.

**Movies and Series**

Enjoy your VOD library with a movie and series focused interface, season and episode navigation, cast and director information, and available trailers and metadata.

The Continue Watching feature helps you resume movies and episodes from where you stopped. With Next Up, you can quickly move to the next available movie or episode.

**EPG and Live TV**

Use the Electronic Program Guide to view program information for supported channels. Depending on the available EPG data, you can view current, upcoming and previous program information.

**Mobile and Tablet Support**

Ray Player is not limited to TV devices. Use it on phones and tablets with responsive portrait and landscape layouts designed for different screen sizes.

**Profiles and Controls**

Create multiple profiles to separate viewing preferences and playback experiences. Parental controls and PIN protection can help restrict access to selected content.

**Use Your Own Content**

Ray Player is a media player, not a content provider. The app does not include channels, movies, series, sports streams or IPTV subscriptions.

Only add playlists, streams and media sources that you have the legal right to access and use.

Manage your own IPTV and media sources with Ray Player — a modern player for Android TV, TV Box, phones and tablets.

_____________________________________

description:
# Jeter Player: The Ultimate High-Performance Video Player

Experience the fastest, most fluid video player designed for massive local libraries. Whether you have hundreds or thousands of videos, Jeter Player launches instantly and keeps your experience distraction-free. No lags, no clutter—just pure immersion.

### 🚀 Built for Speed, Optimized for Scale

Most players slow down as your library grows. Jeter Player is different. Built from the ground up to handle massive collections, it scans folders in seconds and caches metadata locally for an instant-on experience.

### 🌌 Key Features for Power Users

* **Recursive Folder Browsing:** Organize and browse your content exactly how it’s stored on your device.

* **Smart Bookmarks with Memos:** Don't just save a timestamp—add a note to remember why that moment mattered. Access them directly from your Home screen.

* **Private Vault:** Keep sensitive videos out of sight. Long-press to move files into a private, app-only space locked behind Fingerprint, Face Unlock, or PIN.

* **Jeter Lab (Beta):** Experience the future of playback with **AI Frame Interpolation** (smooth 30fps to 60fps), Network Streaming (SMB/WebDAV), and GIF/MP4 clip capture.

* **Short Clips View:** A dedicated space to quickly find and enjoy all your videos under 60 seconds.

### 🛠 Seamless Control & Customization

* **Intuitive Gestures:** Swipe for volume/brightness, horizontal swipe for scrubbing, and double-tap to seek. Long-press for 2× speed.

* **Picture-in-Picture:** Keep watching in a floating window while you use other apps. (Background audio with the screen off is part of Lifetime Access — see below.)

* **Dynamic UI:** Support for Android’s Dynamic Color, adjustable UI scales, and Light/Dark themes.

* **Hearing Protection:** Configurable headphone volume limits to keep your ears safe.

### 💎 Lifetime Access: One Payment, Yours Forever

Unlock the full experience with a single one-time purchase—no subscription, nothing to renew:

* **Ad-Free Playback:** No banners and no interstitial interruptions, ever.

* **Background & Lock-Screen Playback:** Keep the audio going with the screen off or while you use other apps.

* **The Full Toolkit:** Unlimited video compression, Dropbox backup, and screen recording.

* **Or try it free:** Watch a short rewarded ad to get a 30-minute Plus Pass and use the same premium features—no purchase required.

### 📂 Technical Specs & Compatibility

* **Powered by Media3/ExoPlayer:** Support for MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, FLV, WebM, TS, and more.

* **Video Codecs:** H.264, H.265 (HEVC), VP9, AV1 and more are decoded by your phone's own decoders, so support depends on your device.

* **Built-in Audio Decoders:** AC-3, MP3, Opus, Vorbis, FLAC and ALAC play with sound even on phones that can't decode them natively. AAC is always supported.

* **Not Supported:** E-AC-3, TrueHD and DTS / DTS-HD audio require paid licenses. If a video uses one of them, Jeter tells you which format it is and how to convert it.

* **Smart Decoding:** Automatic (recommended) uses hardware first and falls back to the built-in decoders; you can also force Hardware-only or prefer Software decoding.

* **Backup & Sync:** Connect Dropbox to back up your settings, bookmarks, and playlists effortlessly.

**Jeter Player: The Next Generation of Video Playback. Experience it now.**

Hide personal videos and music in a private folder locked with a PIN or your fingerprint. Hidden files disappear from your gallery and from other apps, and screenshots are blocked while they play.

Choose from 0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, or 2x presets to instantly create a slow motion or sped-up video.

With Pro, use the slider to set any speed from 0.02x to 20x.

2. Change the Speed, Keep the Pitch

Choose "Change" to let the pitch follow the speed, or "Keep" to change only the speed and preserve the original pitch.

Voices stay natural: no chipmunk effect when speeding up, no deep, dragging voices when slowing down.

With Pro, you can also mute the audio and export the video without sound.

3. Trim Only the Part You Need

Drag the start and end handles on the thumbnail timeline to select a range.

Cut out just the scene you want and apply slow motion or fast forward to that part only.

4. Flip Horizontally and Loop the Preview

Flip the video horizontally before saving. Ideal for fixing mirrored front-camera videos.

With Pro, you can loop the preview while fine-tuning your settings.

Select several videos and convert them together with the same speed and settings.

In the output settings, choose the resolution (480p, 720p, or original) and the frame rate (1 to 60 fps).

MADE FOR ANDROID TV, PHONES AND TABLETS

On Android phones and tablets, the interface adapts to touch controls and different screen sizes, allowing you to browse and play your sources directly from your mobile device.

Add your own IPTV playlist using an M3U or M3U8 URL. ClearIPTV organizes the channels, groups and categories supplied by your playlist in a simple and readable interface.

OPTIONAL XMLTV AND EPG GUIDE

If your M3U or M3U8 source provides a separate TV guide, add its XMLTV URL to display the available EPG program information.

View current and upcoming programs when compatible guide data is supplied by your source.

XTREAM CODES-COMPATIBLE PLAYER

Connect your own Xtream Codes-compatible source using its server address, username and password.

ClearIPTV organizes the Live TV channels, groups, categories, movies, series and program information supplied by your source.

LIVE TV AND FAST CHANNEL ZAPPING

Browse Live TV channels by group, keep favorite channels and groups easy to reach, and switch channels quickly.

Use your Android TV remote or the touch controls available on Android phones and tablets.

MOVIES, SERIES AND CONTINUE WATCHING

Explore the movies and series provided by your connected source.

Browse categories, search for content, open detailed pages and resume supported movies or episodes from where you stopped.

MULTIPLE PROFILES AND IPTV SOURCES

Manage several profiles, M3U playlists or Xtream Codes-compatible sources from one clear interface.

Each profile and source remains organized and easy to access across Android TV, phones and tablets.

MAIN FEATURES

• IPTV player for Android TV, phones and tablets

• M3U and M3U8 playlist support

• Optional XMLTV URL and EPG guide

• Xtream Codes-compatible login

• Live TV channels and groups

• Fast channel switching and zapping

• Favorite channels and favorite groups

• Current and upcoming program information

• Movies and series from your sources

• Continue Watching

• Content search

• Multiple profiles and IPTV sources

• Remote control and touch navigation

• Interfaces adapted to TV, mobile and tablet screens

IMPORTANT

ClearIPTV is a media player only. It does not provide, sell, host or include TV channels, playlists, IPTV subscriptions, movies, series or any other content.

You must add your own legally obtained M3U/M3U8 playlist or your own Xtream Codes-compatible credentials.

Content availability, program information and playback quality depend on your source, device and internet connection.

ClearIPTV is independent and is not affiliated with any content provider.

Developed in Angers, France.

description:
Need to make a large video smaller before sending or saving it?

Large video files can quickly take up valuable storage space and may be difficult to share or transfer. Video Compressor lets you reduce size with flexible settings for different needs. Select a video from your device, choose the compression options, and create a smaller file while keeping control over the final output. compress videos when you need a more manageable file for storage, sharing, or transfer.

Video Compressor adjusts the resolution, bitrate, and frame rate. You can compress videos based on the output size and quality you want. Resolution controls the dimensions of the output video, while bitrate controls the amount of data used during video compression. You can also adjust the frame rate to suit the video type and reduce size without changing the original file.

Key Features

• Reduce Size – Compress large video files by adjusting resolution, bitrate, and frame rate according to your needs. You can also reduce size when preparing videos for storage or transfer.

• Multiple Resolution Options – Choose from 360p, SD, HD, FHD, 2K, and 4K resolutions based on the available options for your video.

• Frame Rate Control – Select 60 FPS or 30 FPS to customize the output settings and manage video size.

• Bitrate Adjustment – Video Compressor lets you adjust the bitrate to control the file size of your compressed video and reduce size as needed.

• Audio Track Option – Choose whether to keep the audio track when you compress videos.

• Fast Processing Option – Use video compress settings to enable fast processing when you want to reduce processing time.

• Estimated Size Preview – Check the estimated output size before video compression and compare it with the original file size.

• Multiple Video Formats – Select from MP4, MOV, HEVC, and MKV format options when available. You can also use the app as a 4k compressor when working with supported 4K videos.

• Video Information – Video Compressor lets you view details such as the video name, original size, duration, and estimated compressed size before processing.

Who Can Use It?

► Students: Reduce large videos before submitting projects or sharing class work.

► Business Professionals: Make video files smaller for work-related sharing and transfers.

► Content Creators: Reduce large recordings for easier storage and compress videos when needed.

► Travelers: Video Compressor lets you shrink videos to save storage space on your devices. It can also work as a 4k compressor for supported high-resolution videos.

Download → Video Compressor and discover a convenient way to manage large video files. Use video compression to create smaller files, video compress settings when needed, and compress videos for everyday use while you reduce size.

Fully Video Kiosk is a flexible Android Video Kiosk. Configure your video playlist or picture slideshow and Lockdown your device in Kiosk Mode. Fully Video Kiosk provides fullscreen kiosk mode, motion detection, remote admin and many other features for your video kiosks, digital signages, interactive kiosk systems, information panels and any unattended Android devices.

FEATURE OVERVIEW

* Play media from playlist incl. videos supported by Android, images and websites

* Add media from different sources like web URL, YouTube videos/playlists, files/folders on the internal storage or SD cards

* Loop or skip playing media on timer or user interaction, set transitions, wallpaper and play order

* Show websites (HTTP, HTTPS or FILE) with full support for HTML5, JavaScript, application cache, embedded videos etc.

* Auto reload wallpaper or playlist on different events like idle time, network reconnect or screen on

* Configure your device for the best user experience: fullscreen mode, set screen brightness/orientation, keep screen on, skip the lockscreen, autostart, scheduled wake-up and sleep times, screensaver

* Kiosk Mode: Video player lockdown for unattended devices. Exit from Kiosk mode only with selected gesture and PIN.

* Motion Detection using front cam gets more attention, show screensaver or turn screen off when no motion

* Device Movement Detection using compass, accelerometer or iBeacons, theft alarm or other action

* JavaScript and REST Interface: control device and get device info

* Remote Admin Fully Kiosk in the local network or worldwide from Fully Cloud

* Recover the app even after unexpected errors or auto-updates

* Lightweight app, install from Google Play or from APK file, export/import settings, usage stats

* Purchase an instant license for the PLUS features

* Easy volume licensing and deployment, customized and white label solutions

* Supports Android 6 to 17

Full list of features: https://play.fully-kiosk.com/#video-kiosk

If you need any other features for your use case just ask us.

PERMISSIONS

This app uses the Device Administrator permission. This is required when activating Screen Off Timer, Remote Admin or JavaScript Interface for switching off the screen. Administration permission must be withdrawn before the app can be uninstalled.

Accessibility Service Notice: This app uses Android's Accessibility Service exclusively to support kiosk mode. The service prevents access to the status bar, notification shade, and certain system dialogs so the device remains locked to the designated application. No personal data, typed text, or accessibility event information is collected, stored, or transmitted.

Full list of permissions: https://play.fully-kiosk.com/#permissions

USAGE

When Fully Video Kiosk is launched SWIPE FROM THE LEFT EDGE or press and hold the back button to show menu and settings.

In the Kiosk Mode Fully will set as home app. You'll stay locked down with Fully Video Kiosk. The Android status bar, the recent app button and the hardware buttons can also be locked. No root required.

The Motion Detection uses the front camera or microphone of the device. When motion is detected the screen is switched on and screensaver stops.

Read more about configuration options: https://play.fully-kiosk.com/#configuration

Enjoy! Your feedback for our video kiosk app is welcome at info@fully-kiosk.com

description:
A goat singing "Merry Christmas", a bird beatboxing, your friend singing heavy metal 🎤

It's, always fun to watch the result, when somebody is edited to sing/say something that was made just from a short mouth opening video.

But the video editing... well... it takes ages ⏳

Introducing "MeMelody - Lip Sync" 🥳 An app that makes lip synchronization easy and fun with unique reusable automation:

Mouth opening scenes -> Audio lip-sync recording -> Generate video, Enjoy 😎

Why did I make this app?

I've been a video editor for 16 years and a programmer for 12 years. I created lip sync videos with famous desktop editing tools. An AMV of 4 minutes took me 4 months. Hundreds of micro-short videos to match the lip motion. Despite the time, the result was amazing. Got 1.800.000+ views. As a programmer, I've been thinking about how to make a tool, to scale up the production of such high-quality videos with automation. This is how "MeMelody - Lip Sync" was born 🐣

How to use it: (warning, long text ahead)

First, we need to create the mouth opening scenes. Add a video in the "Library" and select it in the "Scene Creator". Navigate to the place where the mouth is opening and see how the frames of your video appeared above the timeline bar. Select the frame where the mouth is fully closed and click the "+Add Frame" button. Select the next frame where the mouth is a little bit open and again click the "+Add Frame". Repeat this until you reached the mouth fully opened frame. Click the save button and you're done 🙌 Good job! You can check your scenes in the Library.

Second, we need to record the lip motion based on an audio file (music/speech/talk...). Add an audio file in the "Library" and select it in the "Editor", the main page. Press the "Lip" then "Play" buttons to start recording the lip motion with the vertical slider. While the audio is playing, move the slider up (mouth open) and down (mouth closed). You can slow down the music to have a more precise result. When you're done, click on the "Lip" button to save and finish your lip motion recording.

Third, select scenes and record the transition between them. From the Library, select multiple scenes you want to use in your video and send them to the "Editor" page. Press the "Scene" then "Play" buttons to start recording the scene transition by tapping on different scenes while the music is playing. This will memorize the order and time when the selected scenes should appear next. When you're done, click the "Scene" button to save and finish your transition recording.

Last, preview and generate the video. Almost there 🏁 Press the play button to preview your outcome. If you want to modify anything, you can repeat the lip motion and scene transition recordings anytime. It will also be saved offline, so you can reuse it anytime. You can also trim the audio by clicking on the start and end times at the desired time positions.

If everything is alright, press the "Save" button, wait a bit, and... Your video is ready! 🥳🥳🥳 YOU DID IT!!! Congratulations! Enjoy 😎

SRT Toolkit PRO sends live video over the SRT protocol — the same low-latency, error-correcting transport broadcasters use — straight into vMix, OBS, TriCaster or any SRT-capable receiver. No capture card, no dongle, no cables.

SENDER

• Stream from the camera or capture the screen

• Caller and Listener modes

• Front or back camera, microphone on or off

• Choose resolution, frame rate and video/audio bitrate

• Horizontal or vertical, with three vertical modes: native, fixed frame (safe for vMix) and crop

MONITOR

• Play any SRT stream with low latency

• Caller and Listener modes

• Live stats: address, mode, latency, uptime, reconnects and resolution

• Automatic reconnection

• Fullscreen playback

WHY SRT

SRT keeps video stable over unreliable networks — mobile data, hotel Wi-Fi, congested links. It recovers lost packets and holds latency predictable, where RTMP simply stalls or drops.

FREE AND PRO

The free version is fully functional and streams with a small watermark. Pro removes it: one-time payment, no subscription. The unlock applies to the device that bought it.

description:
Seamless Video Looper turns a short video clip into a video that loops without a visible jump — the end flows straight back into the beginning. Everything happens on your device: your video is processed entirely on your phone.

HOW IT WORKS

Easy mode: pick a clip, and the app automatically searches the footage for the best loop point — the exact frame pair where the video can repeat cleanly — then generates up to four rendered loop options for you to preview and share. No manual work required.

Advanced mode gives you full control: set the loop point yourself, choose how the loop point is smoothed (Crossfade or a Hard Cut), turn on motion-aware stabilization, and use Key Frames to scan long clips faster. Stabilization does more than fix shaky handheld footage — when supported and enabled it can compensate for camera shift or zoom near the loop point (a slow pan, a walking shot, drone footage, or the subtle drift in AI-generated clips), which is often the difference between an obvious jump and a clean loop. Auto may skip clips where correction would be unnecessary or unreliable. A built-in Hardware Test benchmarks your device so the app can pick the fastest settings it supports.

Renders continue in the background with a progress notification, so you can switch apps or lock your screen while a longer clip finishes.

FEATURES

- Automatic loop-point search — generates up to 4 rendered loop options per clip

- Crossfade or Hard Cut blending at the loop point

- Motion-aware stabilization — when supported and enabled, can align the loop ends on panning, walking, drone, and drifting shots, not just shaky ones

- Optional frame interpolation for smoother blends

- Key Frames coarse scan for faster results on long clips

- Hardware Test to benchmark your device's processing backends

- Background rendering with a progress notification

- Works fully offline — no account required

PRIVACY

Your video file never leaves your device. Loop-point search, blending, stabilization, and rendering are all done locally — your clip is never uploaded, there is no cloud processing, and no account is needed to use the app. The app has no ads and nothing to buy.

The app talks to the network for two things only: feedback you choose to send (your message plus technical details, to help improve the app) and anonymous crash reports so we can fix bugs. Crash reports never include your video. Feedback can include an optional screenshot of the current screen, which may show a video frame — you can turn it off before sending.

Good for turning short clips into wallpaper-style loops, repeating background footage, or clean rendered loops for sharing — without a subscription, an account, or your video going anywhere but your own device.

Made by SciNTech, a small Canadian-based software studio founded by a theoretical physicist — tools rooted in science and feedback loops, no ads and nothing to buy.

• More detailed crash reports, so native crashes can be diagnosed and fixed faster.

description:
Video Compressor & Converter makes your videos smaller and easier to share while keeping the picture as sharp as you want. Choose a quality level, check the estimated size, and the app compresses on your device. Your videos are not uploaded to be compressed. The same app converts video to MP4, trims clips, changes speed, merges videos and saves the soundtrack as MP3.

COMPRESS WITH THE QUALITY YOU WANT

• Three levels: Smallest file, Balanced and Best quality

• Compress from 4K down to 1080p, 720p, 480p or 360p. The app never upscales

• HEVC (H.265) for files about half the size, on phones with an HEVC encoder

• Set the frame rate (24, 30 or 60 fps) or the video bitrate (1 to 12 Mbps) yourself

• See the estimated output size before you start, so the trade-off is clear

• Need a limit? Pick 8, 16 or 25 MB and the app works out the bitrate (any size in MB with Premium)

• Compress up to 3 videos in one go, one after another

• Your original stays as it is. The smaller copy is saved in Movies/Video Compressor

VIDEO CONVERTER: MP4, HEVC OR 3GP

• Convert MKV, WEBM, MOV, TS and other formats your phone can decode to MP4 (H.264 or HEVC) or 3GP

• Choose the resolution and frame rate, so TVs, car screens and video editors can open the file

TRIM, SPEED AND MERGE

• Video cutter: trim with start and end handles. When the format allows, the cut is copied without re-encoding, so quality stays the same

• Change video speed from 0.5× to 2×

• Merge videos one after another, side by side, or top and bottom

VIDEO TO MP3 AND MUTE

• Extract the audio from a video as MP3 or AAC (M4A), from 64 to 320 kbps

• Mute a video: remove the sound and keep the picture

STUDIO AND RECENT FILES

• Studio holds extra tools, including Compress photos for a size limit per photo

• Play the result right away, or share it to chat apps, email or cloud storage

• Recent files: play, share, rename, delete or send a file on to another tool

• Light and dark theme, in English and Vietnamese

WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR

• Making a long clip lighter without it looking worse than it has to

• Freeing up phone storage without deleting videos

• Fixing a video that a TV, car player or older phone will not play

• Cutting a long recording down to the part worth keeping

FREE, CREDITS, 24-HOUR PASS AND PREMIUM

Compressing, converting, trimming, merging and extracting audio are free up to 720p, with no watermark and no sign-up. On the free plan, 1080p output uses 1 credit per file, 4K uses 2 credits per file, and audio above 192 kbps uses 1 credit. You start with 5 credits and get 1 more for each short rewarded ad (up to 5 a day), or you can buy a credit pack. If an export fails, its credit is returned.

For a bigger job, watch one short video for a 24-hour pass (once a day): 1080p and higher without credits, your own size in MB and more than 3 videos at a time.

Premium removes ads, needs no credits and keeps these on:

• A target file size of any number of MB

• Fast mode, which uses the phone's hardware encoder first and stops if the phone gets too hot

• Replace original: the original is backed up for 24 hours, and you can undo from the result screen

• Batch compression with no limit on the number of videos

QUICK ANSWERS

• Are my videos uploaded? No. Compression runs on your device. Ads, analytics and in-app purchases use the internet.

• Will I lose quality? You choose. Best quality keeps more detail, Smallest file saves more space, and the size estimate shows the trade-off before you start.

• Where are my files? Videos go to Movies/Video Compressor and audio to Music, so they show up in your gallery and music player.

• Which phones? Android 8.0 and newer.

Video Compressor & Converter is a video compressor, video converter, MP4 converter, video cutter and video to MP3 tool in one small app: pick a video, pick a quality, compress.

• Import supported PLS, XSPF and JSON playlists

• Browse live channels, categories, favorites and recent channels

• Add an XMLTV guide for now/next information and programme search

POWERFUL PLAYBACK

Play compatible HLS, DASH and Smooth Streaming sources with the native ExoPlayer engine or VLC fallback. Choose available quality, audio and subtitle tracks, adjust aspect ratio, and use picture-in-picture or optional background audio. Custom headers and supported DRM settings are available only for sources you are entitled to access.

BUILT FOR PHONE AND TV

The responsive dark interface works on Android phones, tablets and Android TV. Touch, remote and D-pad navigation make large libraries easy to browse.

PRIVACY AND CONTROL

Playlist URLs, provider credentials, channel data and playback settings are encrypted locally with an Android Keystore-backed key. Provider and catalogue requests go directly to the provider you choose. No playlist, stream or viewing history is sent to Hostragons or attached to advertising requests. Android cloud backup and device-transfer backup are disabled.

FAIR, OPTIONAL PRO

The free player uses consent-aware advertising only on content-bearing Channels and Favorites screens. Ads never cover the video player and are suppressed during playback, picture-in-picture and background audio. Optional annual Hostragons Pro removes all ads. The subscription renews automatically until cancelled in Google Play; price and availability are shown by Google Play. The core player needs no account. Google sign-in is used only when you choose Pro purchase, restore or account controls.

Playback quality, guide accuracy, catalogue availability and catch-up support depend on your provider, device, network and source format. Use only sources and media you are legally entitled to access.

Pro: Sort favorite channels by recently watched. Cancel in Google Play: Payments & subscriptions, then Subscriptions.

description:
Lyrical Video Maker turns a song and its words into a finished lyric video, right on your phone.

Nothing is uploaded. Your music, your lyrics and your finished videos stay on your device, so there is no account on a server, no waiting in a render queue, and no internet needed to make a video.

How it works

1. Add your song. MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG and FLAC all work.

2. Type or paste your lyrics, one line per screen. Already have a timed .lrc file? It is used exactly as written.

3. Pick a style from 56 built-in looks.

4. Make the video. It renders on your phone and lands in your library, ready to share.

Lyric timing you control

The app listens to the shape of your track and places each line for you, skipping instrumental sections so your words do not appear over a solo. From there you stay in charge:

- Tap sync: play the song and tap once as each line starts. Your reaction delay is corrected automatically, and one mistimed tap costs a single undo, not a restart.

- Nudge any line forward or back in small steps.

- Import a .lrc file if you already have exact timings.

56 styles, in six families

Clean, Neon, Cinematic, Organic, Retro and Bold. Every style has its own background motion, typography and entrance animation, from quiet paper-and-ink to neon grids, waveforms that move with your track, starfields and stage spotlights.

You are not limited to one look per video. Change the style partway through, so your chorus can look different from your verse, with a smooth cross-fade at the switch.

Two ways to work

Quick video is the fast path: add, paste, pick, done.

Advanced editor gives you line-by-line control: text size, position on the frame, colour, entrance motion and exact start and end times for every single line. Set one line the way you want it and apply it to the rest in one tap.

Built for where your video is going

- 16:9 for YouTube

- 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and Stories

- 1:1 for feed posts

- 540p, 720p or 1080p

No watermark

Your video is yours. Nothing is stamped on it.

How credits work

One credit makes one video of any length. You get one free credit every day, plus one when you create your profile. If you want more on the same day, you can watch a short video ad for an extra credit, up to five a day. The limit resets at midnight.

Also in the app

- Light and dark themes

Please note

Use music and lyrics that you own or have permission to use. This app does not supply music and does not grant you any rights to songs you do not own.

Type 10 MB. Get a video under 10 MB, checked. Raccoon compresses your video to the exact size your app accepts, then measures the finished file and squeezes it again if it is even slightly over.

Video too large to send? Most compressors make you guess with "low, medium, high" and the result still bounces off the upload limit. Raccoon works backwards from the number that matters: it reads the real length, resolution, frame rate and bitrate of your clip, plans the bitrate that lands just under your limit, and verifies the result.

★ FITS EVERY LIMIT

• One tap for the limits people actually hit: Discord 10 MB, Discord Nitro Basic 50 MB and Nitro 500 MB, WhatsApp 16 MB, Gmail 25 MB, Outlook 20 MB, Telegram, or any custom size in MB

• Fit Check: after encoding, Raccoon measures the file. If it is over, it re-encodes automatically (up to three passes) and then shows you the proof, for example "9.8 MB ✓ fits Discord 10 MB"

• Compress video to 10MB for the Discord file size limit, or under 16 MB for WhatsApp, without trial and error

• Split to Fit (Pro): when a long video cannot fit at a watchable quality, Raccoon splits it into parts that each fit, for example 3 parts of 9.6 MB for Discord, or 60-second parts for a WhatsApp Status

★ SEE IT BEFORE YOU SAVE

• Predicted file size and a quality rating before you start, plus a tip when a lower resolution would look sharper

• Before/After preview (Pro, one free try): Raccoon encodes a 3-second sample at the planned settings, and a wipe slider compares it with the original frame

★ MORE WAYS TO REDUCE VIDEO SIZE

• Shrink by %: keep 20%, 40% or 60% of the original size with one slider

• Resize video: 4K to 1080p, 720p or 480p

• Trim video to the part you need, mute the audio, or cap 60 fps clips at 30 or 24 fps for smaller files

• H.264 for maximum compatibility, or H.265 (HEVC, Pro) for files up to 40% smaller on phones with a hardware HEVC encoder

• Batch: queue several videos under one target size (up to 3 at once for free)

• Free up storage: shrink big 4K phone videos to a fraction of their size, and the Library shows how much space you saved

• Share to Raccoon from your gallery, then send the result straight back to Discord, WhatsApp or email

★ COOL AND QUICK

Raccoon uses your phone's video hardware for fast MP4 compression. Exports run in the background with a progress notification, keep going with the screen off, and can be cancelled at any time.

★ PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Every video is compressed on your phone. No account, nothing uploaded, and your original is never changed. Compressed copies are saved to your gallery in Movies/Raccoon.

★ WORKS WITH

MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, 3GP and other common formats from phones, cameras and screen recorders. The output is a standard MP4 (H.264 or H.265 with AAC audio) that plays everywhere.

★ FREE AND PRO

Free: exact size with every preset and Fit Check, shrink by %, resize, trim, mute, frame-rate cap, H.264 and batches of up to 3 videos. The free version shows ads.

Pro: Split to Fit, unlimited Before/After previews, H.265 (HEVC), unlimited batches, 256 and 320 kbps audio, and no ads. Choose monthly, yearly (with a free trial when Google Play offers one) or a one-time lifetime purchase; the lifetime price is shown on the first paywall screen, with no account needed. Prefer not to pay? Watch one short ad to use the Pro features for 30 minutes.

Available in English, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Русский, Türkçe, Bahasa Indonesia, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, हिन्दी, 日本語, 한국어 and 简体中文.

Media Studio is a comprehensive mobile media toolkit that brings together nine purpose-built tools for editing audio, video, and images — all in one app, with no subscriptions and no cloud uploads. Every operation runs directly on your device, keeping your files private and your workflow fast.

🎵 Audio Editor

A full-featured audio workstation supporting MP3, AAC, WAV, M4A, OGG, and FLAC. Trim recordings with visual waveform handles, set fade-in and fade-out durations, adjust volume from 0–200%, shift speed from 0.5× to 2.0×, and transpose pitch by ±12 semitones. The De-Noise tool removes background hiss automatically, six Voice FX presets transform vocals with blendable intensity, and six Reverb presets add professional space to any recording. All effects stack and are baked in a single export pass.

🔗 Audio Joiner

Merge any number of audio clips into one continuous track. Arrange files in any order and choose between a hard cut, sequential fade, or true overlapping crossfade with a configurable duration. Files are codec-validated before joining.

🎙️ Extract Streams

Rip the audio track from any video file without re-encoding. The optional Professional Vocal Separator module uses the Demucs neural network to separate vocals from background music on-device, producing two clean output files: isolated vocals and the backing track.

🎬 Video Editor

A non-destructive video editor that combines all effects into a single re-encode pass — no quality loss from chaining tools. Trim clips, speed-ramp any segment (0.25×–2.5×), crop with a real-time overlay, rotate in 90° steps, and choose from six colour grade filters. Fine-tune Brightness, Contrast, Exposure, and Highlights independently. Add a custom text watermark with full control over position, size, opacity, and colour, or burn in subtitles from any SRT or VTT file.

🔗 Video Joiner

Concatenate multiple video clips into a seamless MP4. Choose a hard cut, sequential fade, or overlapping crossfade between clips, with a configurable transition duration. The merged file is named after the first clip in your list.

🖼️ Audio + Image

Pair any audio track with a still image to create a shareable video. Select a JPEG or PNG, load your audio, and the app renders a standard H.264/AAC MP4 whose duration matches the audio exactly — ready for YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, and more. Use a 9:16 image for Shorts and Stories.

✏️ Image Editor

A one-pass image editor for JPEG and PNG files. Lock crops to popular aspect ratios or crop freely, fill empty space with a blurred image or solid colour, flip and rotate, resize to an exact pixel width or target file size, and apply colour grade filters with blendable strength. Colorize the entire image with any colour, fine-tune with Brightness, Contrast, Exposure, and Highlights sliders, and add a text overlay at any of five anchor positions.

🪟 Image Collage

Build free-form photo grids with unlimited nesting. Split any cell into up to a 6×6 sub-grid, nest further with no depth limit, adjust cell size weights for asymmetric layouts, and control the gap between cells with a live slider. Long-press any cell to clear its photo or collapse its sub-tree. Exports a crisp 2048 × 2048 px square JPEG.

🤖 Image AI (Professional module required)

Transform photos into anime-style illustrations on-device using neural style-transfer — no internet needed. Choose from six styles: Cartoon, Ghibli, Hayao, Shinkai, Cute, and Sketch. Select a photo, tap a style, tap Apply Now, and save or share the result.

All nine tools support background processing, so you can leave the screen freely and receive a notification the moment your output is ready.

description:
Tracket helps when you need titles, logos, or stickers to follow a moving subject, or when a handheld shot needs steadier results. It focuses on practical tools that keep your edit under control from start to finish, so you can line up timing, arrange clips, and keep playback responsive while you work. Because projects often involve multiple short clips, the app supports straightforward assembly with clear visual feedback. For sideloading and version management, some users may prefer Tracket APK for direct installation.


Core features in Tracket

Accurate motion tracking

You can set one or two tracking points on a subject, then Tracket follows the movement across the frame. The tracker handles rotation and size changes, which helps with fast action or close ups. After tracking, attach text, stickers, or images so they move with the subject. Labels and logos stay aligned without manual keyframing on every frame.

Subject based stabilization

Tracket stabilizes around the subject you choose to reduce unwanted camera movement. This keeps the focus on people or objects while cutting down shake from handheld shooting. If stabilization creates empty borders, you can fill those edges so the frame remains complete. The result keeps attention on the subject while the background motion is smoothed.

Multi clip timeline and audio

You can trim, move, and combine multiple clips on a full timeline for clear control of sequence order. Tracket makes it simple to shorten scenes, swap positions, and build an edit that fits your idea. You can also add music to tie segments together. This helps build short videos ready for sharing from one place.

Blend modes and opacity controls

Tracket includes blend modes and adjustable opacity for clips and overlays. You can fine tune how layers mix, which is useful for titles, logos, or graphic elements that should sit over footage without blocking it. Subtle adjustments help you find a clean balance between the foreground and background. Changes are visible during preview, so you can refine timing and strength quickly.

Keyframes, speed curves, and export performance

For precise animation, you can set keyframes to control position, opacity, and other values over time. Speed curves adjust timing for ramps and slow motion that feel more natural than fixed speed changes. Proxy previews keep playback responsive during editing, even on longer projects. Final exports use high quality results, and Tracket Pro removes ads while adding advanced tools for deeper control.


Tracket Pro information

Tracket offers an optional Pro upgrade that removes ads and adds advanced tools. This lets users focus on editing without interruptions while gaining extra controls for complex projects. The upgrade is aimed at regular editors who need more headroom as projects grow in scope.


Playback and export behavior in Tracket

Proxy previews are designed to improve editing responsiveness and do not affect final output quality. They temporarily lower preview demand so you can scrub and review without stutter. When you export, Tracket uses the source quality and chosen settings to produce the final video.


How to use Tracket on Android

Getting started is straightforward and does not require prior editing experience. The outline below covers a simple workflow from import to export, and it works for short social videos or quick tests. To begin, download Tracket and open it on your phone.

  1. Open Tracket, create a new project, then import one or more clips you want to edit.
  2. Select a clip, open the tracking tool, place one or two points on your subject, and run the track until the end of the motion.
  3. Attach text, a sticker, or an image to the track, then adjust size, position, and timing so it fits the scene.
  4. If the footage is shaky, apply subject based stabilization and enable border fill when needed to keep the frame complete.
  5. Arrange clips on the timeline, trim edges, add music, preview the result, and then export at the quality that suits your needs.


Start editing with Tracket

Tracket focuses on motion tracking, subject stabilization, and practical timeline tools for mobile edits. It helps align graphics with movement, steady shaky shots, and deliver reliable exports. For stable performance and new tools, consider the Tracket latest version.

description:
Visha-Video Player All Formats suits users who want one app for videos, music, and online shows. It helps you browse your phone’s media quickly, organize files by source, and switch between watching and listening without extra tools. You can also stream popular programs from multiple countries when you do not want to rely only on local files. For quicker access, you can download Visha-Video Player All Formats to manage viewing, privacy, and offline use with straightforward controls.


Visha-Video Player All Formats Features

Privacy Folder for hidden viewing

Visha-Video Player All Formats includes a Privacy Folder that keeps selected videos out of your public gallery. You move sensitive clips into this secure space to reduce accidental exposure when sharing your device. This helps separate personal media from general libraries while keeping playback simple when you need it.

Flexible playback controls for everyday viewing

You can keep videos running in the background or open a floating window to watch while using other apps. The player supports speed control and double tap seek so you can review or skip content with accuracy. A history list makes it easy to resume later, and auto pause after playback helps avoid unwanted continuous play. Multiple audio tracks are supported to match your preferred language or commentary.

Subtitle support and audio track switching

The app lets you browse and download subtitles directly from the player. You can sync timing if lines are early or late so the text matches the scene. When a video includes more than one audio track, you can switch tracks without leaving the screen. This is helpful for multilingual content or alternate mixes.

Online streaming with optional VIP

When you want new content, open the online section to watch movies, TV shows, and variety programs from multiple countries. Streaming within the app organizes browsing and playback in a familiar interface. VIP membership is optional and unlocks ad free viewing, selected exclusive content, and a 1080P mode for supported titles. This gives users a clear choice between free watching and extra perks.

Offline downloads, MP3 conversion, and integrated music player

Visha-Video Player All Formats includes a video and audio downloader for saving supported media to your device. You can also convert a video to MP3 when you only need the audio for offline listening. The built in music player auto detects files on internal storage and SD card, then offers an equalizer, filtering, sorting, and a sleep timer. For organization, you can classify videos by download source, and for personalization you can switch skins to change the look of the app.


How to use Visha-Video Player All Formats

Getting started is direct and takes only a few steps. This quick guide covers local playback, streaming, privacy, and offline use in one flow. If needed, install the Visha-Video Player All Formats APK and then follow the steps below on your Android phone.

  1. Open the app and grant storage permissions so it can find videos and music on your device. The home screen lists folders and recent items for quick access.
  2. Tap any video to start playback. Use the speed control or double tap on the left or right side of the screen to rewind or skip. If you need to multitask, enable the floating window or switch to background play.
  3. For multilingual content, open the subtitle menu to browse or download subtitles, then adjust sync if the text timing is off. If a title includes multiple audio tracks, select the track you prefer from the audio options.
  4. To hide a private clip, open its options and move it to the Privacy Folder. Set a lock method if prompted, then access hidden items from the Privacy section when needed.
  5. For online viewing, open the online tab and select a program to play. If you want offline access, use the download option where available, or convert a video to MP3 when only audio is required. For music, open the music section to browse detected tracks, apply filters, adjust the equalizer, and set a sleep timer.


Start watching and listening in one app

Visha-Video Player All Formats brings local media playback, online streaming, privacy controls, and a music player into a single workflow. If you prefer a simple setup for everyday viewing and offline listening, consider the Visha-Video Player All Formats latest version for a consistent experience across your library and online picks.
